resources.string: Could not read saved PCs. Reopen DeskInk. If this continues, reset its storage in Android Settings.
Could not save this PC. You may need its code on reconnect.

1. Install the APK on your tablet.
2. Settings → About tablet → Software information → tap Build number 7 times.
3. Developer options → USB debugging: on.
4. Connect a USB data cable and allow this PC on the tablet.
5. Run DeskInk-Android.exe on Windows, then enter the PC’s six-digit code here.

Only authorize computers you trust. Turn off USB debugging when you no longer use the USB connection.
